what: This line ensures that `DateTime` objects retain their original timezones when converted to `Time` objects, regardless of the Ruby version being used.
why: This line was introduced to maintain compatibility with older Ruby versions (2.2, 2.3) while Rails 5.0 supported newer versions. The Ruby 2.4 release altered the behavior of the `to_time` method for `DateTime` and `Time` objects, so this compatibility layer prevents breaking changes for existing Rails applications. [2]
next: Before making any changes, verify that this compatibility layer is still necessary for the intended use cases of the application, considering the current Rails version and the Ruby version being used.
